info.name: Green Hero API
info.description: Green Hero admin API examples. Select the Local environment, set the password, and run Login. Run Master List requests to capture seeded IDs, then Room Types, Room Numbers, Cancellation Policies, and Campaigns. Create requests update the corresponding ID variables. Postman stores the refresh cookie automatically.

request.description: Returns 409 if this room is used by a reservation or room-change history.
Server generates all matching daily rows within the range (max 366 days). Omit optional fields to leave existing values unchanged. ISO weekday 1=Monday, 7=Sunday.
Use for different changes per date. For existing dates replace expectedVersion: null with the integer version returned by List Daily Inventory. Max 300 changes, all saved atomically.
